$description: Crayon UI components, for building the interface without reading the prototype's HTML. Sizes are CSS px at 100 % zoom (WebView2 device-independent pixels). Every colour, radius and duration is a token from ../tokens/tokens.json (same names as the CSS variables). Behaviour details live in ../docs/behaviour.md; the prototype (../prototype/index.html) is the source of truth if anything here disagrees.

conventions.font: UI: var(--f-ui) (Segoe UI Variable on Windows). Wordmark only: Instrument Sans 600.
conventions.corners: Slightly filleted, never pills: buttons 9-10, rows 8-10, bars 15-16, menus 12. Round only for colour swatches and comment pins.
conventions.selected: Selected = soft grey (--soft-sel). The violet accent (--accent) is only for state: active-tool dot, comments, ticks, the Crayon switch, AI tags, the agent's icon, focus rings.
conventions.motion: Easing --spring = cubic-bezier(.3,0,.2,1), no overshoot. 140 ms hover/press, 260 ms rows and panels. Skip all animation when the OS asks for reduced motion.
conventions.words: A pen stroke is always a 'sketch' (Sketch 1, Sketch 2...), never 'ink'. Comments, not marks. Sentence case everywhere; no all-caps labels.
conventions.keys: No keyboard shortcuts of Crayon's own (they would clash with Rhino's command line). Only Rhino's own keys and the usual ones inside text fields.
conventions.icons: 24 x 24 grid, round caps and joins, currentColor, stroke 1.6-1.8. Files in ../icons/.

hosts.toolbar-window: A borderless, transparent WebView2 window that floats over the active Rhino viewport and follows it. Holds the toolbar and the option row.
hosts.panel: A normal dockable Rhino panel (Rhino.UI.Panels) hosting a WebView2. Holds the side panel (Sketch, Layers, Agent).
hosts.conduit: Rhino.Display.DisplayConduit. Draws sketches, comment pins, the drawing-plane tint, the 3D cursor and the snap dot in the viewport.

components.what: The dock: five tools in a floating bar.
anatomy: grip (six dots, drag to move)
tool buttons: Select, Pen, Eraser, Marks (comments), Saved views
separator
minimize chevron

states.active: A 4 px --accent dot under the icon (beside it when docked on a side). The dot glides only when you switch tools.
states.minimized: Only the active tool and the chevron remain; the option row hides.
states.crayonOff: Hidden (opacity 0, then visibility hidden after 180 ms).

components.docking: Within 72 px of the left/right edge it docks there and turns vertical; near the top/bottom middle (80 px) it docks there horizontally; else it floats. Double-click the grip resets it to the bottom centre. Position is remembered.
components.motion: Each tool icon plays one moment when it turns on: Pen draws its curve, Marks writes its two lines, the camera blinks its shutter.

components.what: The active tool's options, next to the toolbar.
components.placement: Top/bottom dock: centred beside the toolbar (below a top dock, above a bottom one), 8 px gap. Side dock: level with the tool that opened it.

contents.select: Only when something is selected: 'N selected' · Send to agent (agent icon) · Clear
contents.pen: Object | Plane segmented toggle · plane chip 'On <layer>' x (when drawing on a picked face or the 3D cursor) · colour swatch · Snap shapes checkbox
contents.eraser: 'Drag over sketches or comments' · Clear all sketches (second click confirms: 'Click again to clear')
contents.marks: One line of help: 'Click anywhere to comment. It sticks to surfaces and sketch lines.'
contents.views: Save view · one chip per saved view (x on hover deletes) · 'Named Views' with the sync arrows
contents.cursor: Plane: Surface | Top | Front | Side · Reset

components.rules: Stays open while you draw; never closes on an outside click. At most one line of help text. No black hint bars anywhere.

components.what: Two to four exclusive options (Object | Plane, Surface | Top | Front | Side).
components.motion: The soft-grey thumb slides from the previous choice (260 ms) and never replays.

variants.row: Option-row button: height 30, padding 0 11, radius 10, --well, 500 12px; hover --press
variants.ghost: Panel secondary: transparent with an inset 1 px --line-2 ring, 500 12px
variants.danger: Text --danger; destructive actions always need a second click

components.rules: No blue or black filled buttons. Selected = --soft-sel.

components.what: Every on/off setting except Crayon on/off.

states.on: A hand-drawn tick in --accent that overflows the box (../icons/check-tick.svg), drawn on when checked and rubbed out when unchecked.

components.what: Crayon on / off, in the panel header.
components.behaviour: Off hides the toolbar and option row, switches to plain selecting and rests Crayon's tool ring. Sketches stay on their layers. No message is shown; the grey switch is the only sign. Remembered.
components.rules: Filleted corners and a square-ish knob: not an iOS pill.

size.width: 348 default, 300-640, drag the left edge; double-click the edge resets

anatomy: header
tabs
view (Sketch | Layers | Agent)
footer (Sketch: preset save; Layers: selection bar)
lockup: Crayon mark + 'crayon' wordmark (Instrument Sans 600, 18.5 px), never in an app-icon tile
Agent tab only: History, New chat, divider
Crayon switch
Light / dark (moon / sun)

states.switch: The thumb slides; the chosen tab's icon plays its moment: pencil draws its line; top sheet lifts as the lower layer slides out; the agent's dot lands and its loop draws on.
states.agentCount: A violet count badge (16 px, radius 99, 700 10px) = items sent to the agent.
states.agentBusy: While the agent thinks, the tab's loop runs (see agent-icon).

components.what: One heading style for every section in every tab (Presets, Stroke, 3D cursor, Rhino, Crayon).
anatomy: chevron 12 px (--muted), rotated 90° when open
title: 600 13px --ink, sentence case
note on the right: 400 11.5px --muted (e.g. preset count, '4 objects', '1 item sent to the agent')
optional action (⋯)

components.what: A sample stroke drawn with the current settings.

states.edited: the Stroke heading note shows '<preset>, edited'; the footer offers Save to “<preset>” and Save as new

components.behaviour: Click to use. Double-click renames. Hover shows x to delete. Kept between sessions.

components.what: Weight (1-10 px) and opacity (20-100 %): a soft bar you drag, the value inside.

tokens.fillEdge: 2 px --ink-2 on the right edge of the fill

components.keys: Arrow keys nudge it while focused.

components.what: Four swatches + a rainbow ring that opens the colour picker (turns slowly on hover).
Sketch › 3D cursor: a point that holds a drawing plane and is 'here' for the agent.
anatomy: X / Y / Z fields: 3 columns, height 30, radius 8, inset --line-2 ring, label 600 11px --muted, value 500 12px tabular
Plane: segmented Surface | Top | Front | Side
checkbox: Draw on its plane
checkbox: Agent can use it as “here”
buttons: Place cursor (panel) · Look at it (ghost) · reset (icon, 'Reset to origin')
components.rhino: A point + plane (like a CPlane origin). Draw on its plane = set the active CPlane to it. Look at it = set the view to that plane, centred on the cursor.

anatomy.rhinoLayer: eye · lock · colour swatch · name · count
anatomy.crayonLayer: chevron · eye · lock · swatch · name · count (Sketches, Comments, Curves)
anatomy.item: eye · dot or comment number · name (double-click renames) · AI · details chevron

states.new: flashes --accent-soft once, the first time you see it

components.rules: Flat rows, no card boxes, no thumbnails. No location text ('on Walls') in rows.

components.what: Sends one item to the agent. The deliberate way to give the agent context.
Opens under an item row from its details chevron (22 x 22).
anatomy: info: '<kind> · <length> m long · drawn in <view>' (400 11.5px --muted)
comments only: a text field to edit the comment (height 28, radius 7)
actions (height 26, radius 7, --well): Zoom to fit · Turn into curve (hand-drawn sketches only) · Delete (--danger)

size.indent: content lines up with the row's name (70 px)

components.what: Layers footer while something is selected.
anatomy: 'N selected' (count bold, 4 px gap) · Clear
Send to agent (agent icon) · Turn into curves (when hand-drawn sketches are selected) · Delete
components.rules: Selecting never sends anything to the agent.

components.what: The Thinking loop: a dot circled by one hand-drawn crayon loop. The agent's icon everywhere (tab, Send to agent, Layers note, every reply, the empty state).

parts.echo: the same loop, stroke 1, 30 % opacity, offset (.45, .4): the faint second pass of the hand-drawn tick

motion.appear: dot scales in (300 ms), then the loop draws on (500 ms, from 60 ms), the echo fades in last
motion.thinking: loop: a short stroke chases round it, growing and shrinking (1.4 s, infinite: dasharray .04/.96 → .62/.38 → .04/.96, dashoffset 0 → -1); dot breathes to 68 % scale; echo hidden
motion.settle: when the answer arrives the loop draws itself once, whole, and stays

anatomy: chips of what was sent to the agent (height 24, radius 7, --accent-soft, x removes)
attached files
text field (Return sends, Shift+Return new line, placeholder 'Describe what to build…')
bar: attach · voice · Skill menu · Model menu · send
components.send: 30 x 30, radius 9; grey when empty, fills --accent when there is something to send; the arrow flies up on send
components.voice: violet glow around the panel while listening
components.model: Shows the model's real name (e.g. 'Opus 5.5'). The list comes from the backend: window.Crayon.models.

anatomy: header: agent icon 22 px + 'Thinking' (shimmering --muted text) while working
text: 400 13px
steps: fold-out '<n> steps', each with a small spinner, then a dot
result: check + title + detail · Undo (flips to Redo) · 'Refine it by telling me what to change'
meta (fades in): copy · good · bad · time
components.userMessage: Right-aligned, --well, radius 14, max 86 % width; chips of what was sent sit above it; copy and time underneath
components.rules: No suggested prompts. No 'what should the agent do' question.

components.what: A numbered --accent dot with a white label holding the comment.
components.hover: A small dark tag above it names what it sticks to: 'Sketch · <name> ✎' (click to rename the sketch) or 'Layer · <layer name>'. Never an invented object name.
components.snap: Sticks to a sketch line within 14 px of the pointer, else to the surface under it.

components.what: A small dark chip beside the pointer: 'Sketch · Window idea', 'Layer · Massing'. The layer name comes from Rhino (the object's layer full path).

components.behaviour: Click restores the view instantly (no fly-through), like Rhino's Named Views. Double-click renames. x deletes (the chip folds away, then the sync arrows turn once). Maps 1:1 to _-NamedView Save / Restore / Rename / Delete.
